item.title: Weekly Review
item.description: The head coach of the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign basketball team decried his team’s defense as “doo-doo”; Italian couture brand Miu Miu successfully blocked a Polish beauty company from registering a business named Fiu Fiu; and the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade showcased a sixteen-foot tall Labubu. The post Weekly Review appeared first on Harper's Magazine.

item.description: In Oviedo, Florida, a middle school was placed under lockdown after its AI-automated weapons-detection system spotted a student holding a clarinet like a gun. The post Weekly Review appeared first on Harper's Magazine.

item.title: Weekly Review
item.description: The president met with his former attorney Alan Dershowitz in the Oval Office to discuss a draft of the latter’s book, titled Could President Trump Constitutionally Serve a Third Term? In Guaíba, Brazil, strong winds toppled a 76-foot-tall replica of the Statue of Liberty located in the parking lot of a department store. The post Weekly Review appeared first on Harper's Magazine.

item.title: Weekly Review
item.description: Five days before the U.S. military launched a series of air strikes on northern Venezuela and a Special Forces unit armed with blowtorches broke into a Venezuelan military compound to kidnap that country’s president and his wife, a group of shamans gathered on the Peruvian coast, imbibed hallucinogenic cocktails, and predicted that the Venezuelan president would be removed from office in 2026. The post Weekly Review appeared first on Harper's Magazine.

item.title: Weekly Review
item.description: It was reported that pro-agribusiness messaging permeated certain Brazilian music genres and that Brazil surpassed the American production of beef in 2025, during which time the United States imposed and then revoked a forty percent tariff on Brazilian agricultural imports. item.title: Weekly Review
item.description: In Minnesota, an ICE agent slipped on a sheet of ice; an expedition of the Canadian Coast Guard into the country’s northernmost fjords found that the Arctic’s last remaining floes crack easily; it was determined that Martian lakes may have survived their planet’s paleoclimate by freezing over in a thin seasonal layer; and the U.S. Figure Skating Championships concluded in St. Louis. The post Weekly Review appeared first on Harper's Magazine.
